assets.name: 女の子

Hugging a white plush bunny, cheerful energetic 'one more story!' expression, natural age-appropriate preschool body. Full body solo character, hand-painted anime chibi JRPG style matching reference, bold navy outlines, rich cel shading, recognizable silhouette at small size. Center square transparent alpha canvas with 10% padding, all limbs inside. No background, no floor, no text, no horns, no demon features, no weapon, no other characters.
